metaTitle: Brewing Buddha Case Study: 24M+ Views | Button Up Media
metaDescription: How Button Up Media made short videos for Brewing Buddha Cafe & Arthouse in Pinecrest, a quirky coffee shop and art space, that reached 24M+ video views.
ldHeadline: Brewing Buddha Cafe & Arthouse: 24M+ social video views for a Pinecrest coffee shop
h1Sub: 24M+ video views for a Pinecrest cafe
answer: Brewing Buddha Cafe & Arthouse is a quirky coffee shop and art space in Pinecrest. Our short videos about its creative lattes reached 24M+ views on Instagram, YouTube, TikTok and Facebook.

hero.alt: A Brewing Buddha barista reacts to a party-size Cookie Butter Latte order, from a Reel we made with 7.4M views

metrics.label: Video views
metrics.meaning: Instagram Reels 11.8M, YouTube 6.6M, TikTok 4.0M and Facebook 1.7M, measured in Sprout Social from January 2022 to November 2026.

metrics.label: Followers
metrics.meaning: Across Instagram, Facebook, TikTok and YouTube, with 33.8K of them gained since 2022.

metrics.label: Engagement rate
metrics.meaning: How often people who see a post like, comment or share it. It shows the audience is paying attention, not just scrolling past.

reels.intro: Tap any Reel to watch it with sound. View counts are what Instagram showed on Nov 16, 2026.

paragraphs: Brewing Buddha is a quirky coffee shop and art space known for its creative lattes.
Generic coffee content would have hidden exactly what makes it different. In owner Jordan Athos's words, they needed somebody to match their energy.

items.title: Film what people come for
items.bodyHtml: Short videos built around the creative lattes and the art space.

items.title: Trade ideas both ways
items.bodyHtml: We pitch, they pitch, and the strongest concepts make the feed.

items.title: Let one drink lead
items.bodyHtml: Our February 2025 video on their butter coffee became a standout.

items.title: views on one behind-the-counter skit
items.body: A barista reacts to a party-size Cookie Butter Latte order meant for 10 people. It drew 7.4M views and 576K likes, more than half of all the views across the account's 261 Reels.

items.title: of all Reel views came from three summer skits
items.body: The top three Reels are all staff comedy about over-the-top orders, posted from June to September 2026. Together they drew about 9.4M of the 12.5M views on @brewingbuddha. When a format works, we turn it into a series.

items.title: views on a Reel the audience asked for
items.body: Viewers loved the butter latte video, so the team created a maple waffle latte as a follow-up. Making the next video from what people ask for keeps them coming back.

items.title: and, in the manager's words, “the quality never drops”
items.body: In a November 2026 Google review, manager Josh wrote that the account has “several videos over a million views” and brought “an influx of new customers.”

points: Owner Jordan Athos went on camera in August 2024 to talk about working with us. You can watch it on this page.

quote.text: They bring creative ideas, they're not afraid to push the lines, we needed somebody to match our energy, we bounce off ideas and work as a team.
quote.name: Jordan Athos
